name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Botanist, Captain, and Geologist go with 13 ly, 15 ly, and 19 ly, in some order.
Bauer's distance is lower than both Dasari and the Captain.
At least one of 15 ly goes with Fontaine, Medic does not go with Fontaine, or 15 ly goes with Captain if and only if Botanist does not go with Dasari.
Exactly one of these is true: Cho goes with 15 ly; Dasari goes with Captain; Botanist goes with 21 ly.
17 ly goes with neither Dasari nor Rios.
Between Bauer and Dasari, one goes with Engineer and the other with 13 ly.
Either Bauer goes with Botanist or Captain goes with Rios.
